propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale pinned ticket snapshot because materialize_tickets(fetch=False) uses the local mirror refs/heads/tickets instead of the live store HEAD, causing decisions based on outdated ticket state (status, comments) that differ from the live tracker repo

The verifier receives fenced context from the live store but authoritative show_ticket() calls read the stale pinned snapshot, and the model correctly prefers the pinned snapshot per the documented contract, making the two halves of the gate read inconsistent data

A non-PASS verdict with no findings is coerced to FAIL and synthesizes a fabricated (unspecified) criterion instead of reporting that no usable verdict was obtainable, preventing agents from distinguishing verifier faults from actual unmet criteria

Two independent tickets (cb91 and d4c2) were blocked by the stale snapshot: one presented as stale ticket state (status open, zero comments) and another as search budget exhaustion for evidence that existed but was invisible in the pinned tree
